entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, my VeloBand tracker is not working.
I'm certainly sorry to hear that. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's broken. The heart rate monitor is stuck, and it won't sync with the app. I think it's defective.
I see, thank you for clarifying. I apologize for the inconvenience that's causing. Can I get your name and order number to pull up your account?
Sure. The name is Sarah Jenkins. Order number is VF789012.
Thank you, Sarah. One moment while I look that up... Okay, I see the order. It looks like the VeloBand GPS Tracker was delivered 17 days ago.
If you say so. It doesn't work, so the date doesn't matter.

I understand. Let me just quickly review our return policy for you... Okay, I've confirmed it. Since your item was delivered within the last 90 days, I can go ahead and process a return for a full refund.
Fine. What do I have to do?

I am sending a prepaid return label to the email address on file right now. You just need to print that out, place the defective band back in its original packaging, and drop it off at the post office. Your refund will be issued once we receive the item.
Whatever. I guess that's one way to solve it.
Absolutely. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, Sarah. Have a great day.
